verdict.rationale: Resend documents building email templates with React via React Email and sending them through the API. It also has a Templates feature (tables can be added to Broadcasts and Templates), and hands-on community users praise React-based template authoring. In this pack, though, the evidence never documents merge-field variables, conditionals or loops, and never mentions preview or test-render before sending. missing for 10: documented merge-field/variable syntax, documented conditional and loop constructs, a preview/test-render capability, and independent hands-on evidence of personalization.
